_help: One- or two-sentence summaries of restrictions of use, shown with 「允许使用，有使用限制」. Keys: eu:<FL no.> (Union list column 7) or cn:<GB code>. Reviewed text only; the official text prevails. Category numbers are those of Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 Annex II. cnc:<GB code> = configuration note for a CAS number supplemented by this site.

eu:05.062.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（0.04–2 mg/kg）。
eu:05.062.en: Only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (0.04–2 mg/kg).

eu:05.099.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（0.02–5 mg/kg）。
eu:05.099.en: Only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (0.02–5 mg/kg).

eu:05.229.zh: 限定来源：只限从杠柳（Periploca sepium）中分离得到的该物质。
eu:05.229.en: Source restriction: only when isolated from Periploca sepium.

eu:07.215.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，有最高限量：乳制品 16 mg/kg，其他所列类别 20–100 mg/kg，饮料 50 mg/l（Schwedenbitter 为 850 mg/l）。
eu:07.215.en: Only in the listed food categories, with maximum levels: dairy products 16 mg/kg, other listed categories 20–100 mg/kg, beverages 50 mg/l (Schwedenbitter 850 mg/l).

eu:16.016.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于乳制品、冰淇淋类（各 70 mg/kg）、糖果（100 mg/kg）和非酒精饮料（150 mg/kg）。
eu:16.016.en: As a flavouring, only in dairy products and edible ices (70 mg/kg each), confectionery (100 mg/kg) and non-alcoholic beverages (150 mg/kg).

eu:16.032.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于乳制品（70 mg/kg）和非酒精饮料（100 mg/kg）。
eu:16.032.en: As a flavouring, only in dairy products (70 mg/kg) and non-alcoholic beverages (100 mg/kg).

eu:16.119.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于乳制品（1 mg/kg）、盐、调味料、汤和酱类等（6 mg/kg）和风味饮料（3 mg/kg）。
eu:16.119.en: As a flavouring, only in dairy products (1 mg/kg), salts, seasonings, soups, sauces and similar (6 mg/kg) and flavoured drinks (3 mg/kg).

eu:16.130.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量：多数类别 7–300 mg/kg，汤类和饮料类（12.5、14.1.2–14.1.4、14.2.1、14.2.2、14.2.5）7–10 mg/l；以羧酸及其半硫酸盐一水合物合计、按酸计；Section 2 注 1（盐类视为同一物质）不适用。
eu:16.130.en: Only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level: 7–300 mg/kg in most categories, 7–10 mg/l for soups and beverages (12.5, 14.1.2–14.1.4, 14.2.1, 14.2.2, 14.2.5); as the sum of the acid and its hemisulfate monohydrate salt, expressed as the acid; Section 2 Note 1 (salts covered) does not apply.

eu:16.132.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（200–1000 mg/kg），部分类别只限乳基或大豆基产品。
eu:16.132.en: Only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (200–1000 mg/kg); some categories are limited to dairy-based or soy-based products.

cnc:S1110.zh: 补充的 CAS 为 PubChem 中的特定构型（(3Z,6E)），GB 2760 名称未指定构型。
cnc:S1110.en: The supplemented CAS number is one configuration in PubChem ((3Z,6E)); the GB 2760 name does not specify a configuration.

cnc:S1500.zh: 补充的 CAS 为 PubChem 中的特定构型（(E)），GB 2760 名称未指定构型。
cnc:S1500.en: The supplemented CAS number is one configuration in PubChem ((E)); the GB 2760 name does not specify a configuration.

eu:14.011.zh: 只能用于非酒精饮料和酒精饮料（100 mg/kg）及烈酒（250 mg/kg）；单独或与 FL 14.152、14.155 合计，以奎宁碱计。
eu:14.011.en: Only in non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages (100 mg/kg) and spirit drinks (250 mg/kg); alone or together with FL 14.152 and 14.155, expressed as quinine base.

eu:14.152.zh: 只能用于非酒精饮料和酒精饮料（100 mg/kg）及烈酒（250 mg/kg）；单独或与 FL 14.011、14.155 合计，以奎宁碱计。
eu:14.152.en: Only in non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages (100 mg/kg) and spirit drinks (250 mg/kg); alone or together with FL 14.011 and 14.155, expressed as quinine base.

eu:14.155.zh: 只能用于非酒精饮料和酒精饮料（100 mg/kg）及烈酒（250 mg/kg）；单独或与 FL 14.011、14.152 合计，以奎宁碱计。
eu:14.155.en: Only in non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages (100 mg/kg) and spirit drinks (250 mg/kg); alone or together with FL 14.011 and 14.152, expressed as quinine base.

eu:16.012.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（20–5000 mg/kg，口香糖最高 5000 mg/kg）。
eu:16.012.en: Only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (20–5000 mg/kg; chewing gum up to 5000 mg/kg).

eu:16.048.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别：乳制品、肉、鱼和即食咸味零食 3 g/kg，糖果按需适量，盐、调味料、汤和酱类等 3 g/kg（代盐 40 g/kg），酒精饮料 25 g/l。
eu:16.048.en: Only in the listed food categories: dairy products, meat, fish and savoury snacks 3 g/kg; confectionery quantum satis; salts, seasonings, soups, sauces and similar 3 g/kg (salt substitutes 40 g/kg); alcoholic beverages 25 g/l.

eu:16.060.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（40–5000 mg/kg，口香糖最高 5000 mg/kg）。
eu:16.060.en: Only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (40–5000 mg/kg; chewing gum up to 5000 mg/kg).

eu:16.061.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（3–5 mg/kg）。
eu:16.061.en: As a flavouring, only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (3–5 mg/kg).

eu:16.113.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于列出的食品类别，最高 10 mg/kg。
eu:16.113.en: As a flavouring, only in the listed food categories, at most 10 mg/kg.

eu:16.126.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（3–30 mg/kg）。
eu:16.126.en: As a flavouring, only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (3–30 mg/kg).

eu:16.127.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量：多数类别 4–100 mg/kg；乳基饮料（14.1.4）和乳基甜点（16）各 4 mg/l。
eu:16.127.en: As a flavouring, only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level: 4–100 mg/kg in most categories; dairy-based drinks (14.1.4) and dairy-based desserts (16) 4 mg/l each.

eu:16.133.zh: 只能用于列出的、采用不透光包装的食品类别（3–150 mg/kg）；不得出售给最终消费者；须标示含 FL 16.133 并注明避光，容器须不透光。
eu:16.133.en: Only in the listed food categories in opaque packaging (3–150 mg/kg); not for sale to the final consumer; the label must state that it contains FL 16.133 and must be protected from light, in opaque containers.

eu:16.134.zh: 只能用于口香糖（5.3），不超过 100 mg/kg。
eu:16.134.en: Only in chewing gum (5.3), at most 100 mg/kg.

eu:16.135.zh: 只能用于糖果类：其他糖果（5.1、5.3、5.4 除外）250 mg/kg，口香糖 500 mg/kg，装饰、浇头和甜酱 150 mg/kg。
eu:16.135.en: Only in confectionery: other confectionery (other than 5.1, 5.3 and 5.4) 250 mg/kg, chewing gum 500 mg/kg, decorations, toppings and sweet sauces 150 mg/kg.

eu:16.136.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（1.7–20 mg/kg），部分类别只限干酪类似物或蔬菜。
eu:16.136.en: Only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (1.7–20 mg/kg); some categories are limited to cheese analogues or vegetables.

eu:16.137.zh: 只能用于列出的食品类别，最高 10 mg/kg；部分类别只限特定产品（咸味饼干，乳、乳类似物和果蔬基甜点）。
eu:16.137.en: Only in the listed food categories, at most 10 mg/kg; some categories are limited to particular products (savoury crackers; dairy, dairy-analogue, fruit- and vegetable-based desserts).

eu:17.038.zh: 作为香料使用时，只能用于列出的食品类别，各类别有最高限量（15–160 mg/kg）。
eu:17.038.en: As a flavouring, only in the listed food categories, each with a maximum level (15–160 mg/kg).
